description: Get ready for a full weekend of food, family, and unforgettable energy! From Food Truck Friday to an action-packed Saturday with live DJs, a kids zone, and community celebration—this is an event you don’t want to miss. 🗓️ April 17–18 📍 Friday: 4 PM – 9 PM | Saturday: 12 PM – 9 PM
title: Greek Fest 2026 — Khalifa For Congress
